messages:
sara_sales: Quick heads-up — large prospect (ECS Corp) asking for 40% off on a $500k annual commit if we fast-track a POC and Private deployment. They want contract signed by EOW.

mike_dealdesk: 40% is way outside standard. What’s their play — multi-year? any logo value?

sara_sales: 12 months, single-region, wants Dedicated w/ VPC. Strong logo, potential upsell across 3 lines. POC is 4-week, they need SOC2 + customer-managed KMS.

alex_se: For POC we can spin a non-prod Private replica but need SRE help. Quick questions: do they need 1:1 GPUs? expected QPS? any special quantization/FP constraints?

sara_sales: ~200 QPS peak, ~50 concurrent streams. SE said medium GPUs likely fine but perf unknown until profiling. They also want live streaming and function-calls enabled.

pricing-bot: Standard rate card: https://redwood.example/pricing (tier: enterprise). Default discount cap for first-year commit is 25%. Use /discount-check to validate exceptions.

jamie_finance: Finance note: at $500k, 40% = $200k credit — unacceptable without margin recovery or multi-year commit. Options: 30% with 2-year, or $75k up-front credit + usage-based rebate tied to 6-month ramp.

mike_dealdesk: Propose counter: 30% first-year cap + $50k POC credit, plus an option to revisit at renewal. Any ask >25% requires director sign-off.

lee_security: Security flag: customer insists on Private deployment and will run a security questionnaire. We need signed DPA + SOC2 Type II evidence before production. For POC we can offer an isolated hosted sandbox with IP allowlist and data controls.

sara_sales: They said legal will sign DPA quickly. Is SOC2 evidence enough to unblock Dedicated?

lee_security: SOC2 and a short security addendum required. For Dedicated we also need KMS integration details. POC in hosted isolated mode reduces risk footprint.

alex_se: Technical ask: can we provide a 4-week POC in isolated hosted env with token caps, tracing, and sample metrics? If yes, we avoid standing up Dedicated for eval. Also need sample prompt set to pre-warm KV cache.

sara_sales: Customer ok with hosted POC if it's isolated and we provide KMS-proof-of-concept later. They want pricing confirmed before starting.

mike_dealdesk: @jamie_finance please confirm approval to offer $50k POC credit + 25-30% discount band. I recommend locking at 25% now and offering a 5% uplift if they sign 2-year.

jamie_finance: Approved: $50k POC credit + up to 25% discount for year 1. If they commit 2 years or increase ARR to >$800k, we can consider an additional 5% credit at renewal. Any higher concession needs VP sign-off.

sara_sales: Perfect — I'll send counter: $500k commit, $50k POC credit, 25% first-year discount, SOC2 + DPA, POC in isolated hosted env. Ask for EOW signature.

mike_dealdesk: I'll draft the concession memo and attach to SFDC opp. Send me the opp ID and the POC scope doc. :thumbsup:

alex_se: I'll prepare a POC runbook and resource estimate. Will ping eng-infra for temporary quotas.

lee_security: I'll prepare a short security checklist we can share with the customer to speed SOC2 verification.

sara_sales: Thanks team — looping legal and customer now. Will update thread with opp ID and signed DPA when available.
